notes: Check 1 (clarity_timeline) read every Clarity update. 2024 general: precinct numbers in all 7 election-night updates; the 7:19 PM and 7:26 PM updates are early vote and mail only, election-day precinct votes first at 9:51 PM CST and grow through 2:25 AM. 2026 primary: 9:01 PM update has early-vote precinct numbers, election-day precinct votes in 10:19 PM, 11:19 PM and 12:21 AM updates. 2026 runoff: the precinct-level vote values in detailxml.zip and json/ALL.json read "protected" in every election-night version, while json/en/summary.json carried county totals from 7:51 PM CDT; precinct numbers first appear in the 5/27/2026 12:32 PM CDT version. Several versions returned HTTP 404 (8 in 2024, 14 in 2026 primary, 5 in runoff); the runoff 404 version 373135 is numbered immediately before 373136 (5/27 12:32 PM), and the last readable night version 373064 (12:04 AM) had protected precinct values, so no night version with precinct numbers was seen. Wayback branch origin/wayback-data was not present when checked (check 3 not needed). County results page votetravis.gov links to Clarity for election night results.
tag_rationale: 2024 general and 2026 primary are both LIVE by check 1, so two elections share LIVE and the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT; settled by check 1, so confidence high.

2024_general.night_updates_with_precinct_numbers: 7 of 7 (5 with election-day votes, first 2024-11-05 21:51 CT)
2024_general.fact: Clarity update log: election-night versions at 7:19, 7:26, 9:51, 10:53, 11:31 PM, 12:35 and 2:25 AM CST each have 286 precincts with nonzero candidate votes; Election Day vote type precinct sums rise from 0 (7:26 PM) to 541732 (9:51 PM) to 2992207 (12:35 AM).

2026_primary.night_updates_with_precinct_numbers: 4 of 4 (3 with election-day votes, first 2026-03-03 22:19 CT)
2026_primary.fact: Clarity update log: election-night versions at 9:01 PM, 10:19 PM, 11:19 PM CST and 12:21 AM have 296 to 297 precincts with nonzero votes; Election Day precinct sums 0, 1478212, 3529699, 4272210.

2026_runoff.fact: Night versions 7:48 PM to 12:04 AM CDT: detailxml.zip and json/ALL.json precinct values read "protected"; summary.json shows county totals (DEM Lieutenant Governor V [4404, 28200] at 7:51 PM, [7805, 45748] at 12:04 AM). First version with precinct numbers: 5/27/2026 12:32:52 PM CDT (296 precincts). Precinct numbers came after election night.
